results.content: Within the group of people who say they voted for Trump in 2024, the average predicted Trump support fell by 0.4 points from May 2025 through August 2026 — well within the margin of error for both the individual polls (around 2.5% in the average month) and the trend visualized below (about 1.5%). I have removed the Y axis values from this chart because the thing to focus on is the “lack of” trend, not the level.
